  "fixed_xml": "<ITEM>20. <BIBL><TITLE>Falckeisische Bibel</TITLE> noch gantz neu in <FORMAT>Schweins-leder</FORMAT> gebunden, à <PRIZE>12. Gulden</PRIZE></BIBL>, oder gegen einem neuen <BIBL><TITLE>Corpore Juris</TITLE>, <PLACE>Leipziger Edition</PLACE></BIBL>, zu vertauschen.</ITEM>",
  "number_of_fixes": 2,
  "explanation": "1) The second <BIBL> element (for the 'Corpore Juris') was opened but never closed. This made the XML malformed, because </ITEM> appeared while <BIBL> was still open. A closing </BIBL> tag was added directly after <PLACE>Leipziger Edition</PLACE>. This keeps the bibliographic description (title and edition) inside the element, while the trailing phrase ', zu vertauschen.' ('to be exchanged') stays outside it as part of the item text. This mirrors the structure of the first <BIBL>, which contains only the bibliographic and descriptive details. 2) The character sequence '\\u221a\\u2020' ('√†') is a classic encoding error (mojibake): the UTF-8 bytes of 'à' (C3 A0) were misread as Mac Roman. It was corrected to 'à', the price preposition used in 18th-century German advertisements ('à 12. Gulden' = 'at 12 guilders'). No other tags were changed. The existing element names (e.g. PRIZE, FORMAT, PLACE) were kept as they appear to be part of the project's tagging schema."
}
